$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-tabs__trigger) and how to read it.

root.$why: The trigger hugs its label, whose width follows glyph rasterisation (the size check covers it). Figma's root wraps a content frame that carries the gap; in code the trigger lays its parts out itself (the stacked layouts keep the root's 8 px gap).

Indicator.$why: The bar is the trigger's ::after, which the spec check cannot select; the pixel check covers its size, place and colour.
